task: 修复 Fovelle GitHub Actions 检查失败

verification_scope.remote_reexecution_note: 本次修复未执行 push 或远端工作流重跑；远端链接记录的是修复前的失败/对照运行。

research_trace.finding: The latest Build Fovelle run for commit 7dc0c64 passed its first complete FovelleTests execution, then FovelleTaskAcceptanceAudit failed CI-UNIT-002 and CI-INTEGRATION-001.
research_trace.premise: The hosted run log and its emitted failed case IDs are the authoritative observation for the current failure.

research_trace.finding: The companion Checks workflow passed the same source revision and environment contract; earlier same-day runs alternated between a unit-only audit failure and an integration-only audit failure while the first complete FovelleTests execution passed.
research_trace.premise: Source-identical pass/fail counterexamples exclude a deterministic compile or product-output regression and point to a timing-sensitive observation inside the duplicated audit executions.

research_trace.finding: The failed job records macos-26-arm64 image 20260728.0273.1, macOS 26.5.2, Xcode 26.6, SDK 26.5, and Qt 6.11.2; GitHub's runner inventory maps macos-26 to the arm64 image.
research_trace.premise: Reproduction must distinguish the hosted window-system schedule from the Qt version; local Qt 6.11.2 alone is not the complete environment.

research_trace.finding: The test installed a viewport PaintRegionRecorder, waited for at least one paint, then used the maximum area across every paint observed during that wait as if every event had been caused by the scrollbar move.
research_trace.premise: The assertion is valid only if no independently scheduled refinement paint can arrive while the recorder remains installed.

research_trace.finding: Qt 6.11.2 implements QTRY_VERIFY_WITH_TIMEOUT by repeatedly calling QTest::qWait while allowing event processing, normally in 50 ms steps.
research_trace.premise: The wait for the first paint can dispatch more than one queued paint before the condition is evaluated again, so recorder length and event ordering vary with runner scheduling.

research_trace.finding: Qt documents that QFutureWatcher emits finished when its asynchronous computation completes; Fovelle connects that signal to asyncVectorTileFinished, which retains the tile and schedules an item update.
research_trace.premise: A vector refinement paint is independently eligible to enter the same event-processing window as the exposed-strip paint.

research_trace.finding: Qt documents that scrolling requires only partial invalidation, while a distinct scene/item update follows the configured viewport update policy.
research_trace.premise: The exposed strip and the later refinement are two different causes and must be evaluated as separate observations.

research_trace.finding: After waiting for refinement to settle, one test execution observed two paints: the first scroll paint had dirty_ratio 0.009554 and the later maximum was 1.000000; the former implementation failed solely because it asserted the maximum.
research_trace.premise: One execution containing both a valid strip and a valid later full refinement disproves the assumption that maximum recorded area measures scroll reuse.

research_trace.finding: The test now attributes only the first paint to the scrollbar move, waits until vector refinement is no longer pending for safe teardown, and records the later maximum only as diagnostic output.
research_trace.premise: This preserves the 5% exposed-strip performance assertion without accepting a full scroll repaint or suppressing the asynchronous refinement path.

research_trace.finding: The repaired atomic case passes with Qt 6.11.2 while deliberately observing dirty_ratio 0.009554, max_observed_dirty_ratio 1.000000, and paint_events 2.
research_trace.premise: The verification directly exercises the scheduling shape that made both CI-UNIT-002 and the nested CI-INTEGRATION-001 fail.

research_trace.finding: The earlier Release-only minos and bundled Ghostscript repair remains independently covered by its version, source-build, and dry-run cases.
research_trace.premise: The current GUI observation repair neither weakens nor replaces the already established macOS 15 release controls.

research_trace.finding: Both failed case IDs execute the same vector-pan test, directly or through FovelleTests; correcting that test's causal event attribution removes their shared false-negative path.
research_trace.premise: One root cause and one observer-level repair explain both failures while keeping the production rendering implementation and its performance threshold unchanged.

observations: 最新 Build Fovelle run 的首轮 FovelleTests 通过；验收审计静态与系统阶段分别 7/7、3/3，unit 失败 CI-UNIT-002，integration 失败 CI-INTEGRATION-001。
同提交的 Checks workflow 全部通过；前一提交的两个并行 workflow 又分别出现 unit-only 与 integration-only 验收失败，构成源码相同、结果相反的时序反例。
CI-UNIT-002 直接执行 testVectorPanRepaintsOnlyExposedStrip，CI-INTEGRATION-001 通过完整 FovelleTests 再次执行同一方法，两项存在共同失败点。
Qt 6.11.2 的 QTRY_VERIFY_WITH_TIMEOUT 通过 QTest::qWait 反复泵送事件；旧测试在此期间记录全部 Paint 并取最大面积，无法区分滚动暴露条带与 QFutureWatcher 完成后安排的 refinement Paint。
控制复现等待 refinement 后观测到 dirty_ratio=0.009554、max_observed_dirty_ratio=1.000000、paint_events=2；旧最大值断言失败，新首事件断言在完全相同的渲染序列中通过。
Release 的 Deploy/Package 阶段报告 minos 15.7.5，并在旧比较器中出现 7.5 的 Bash arithmetic syntax error。
同一失败步骤指出 build/Fovelle.app/Contents/Resources/ghostscript/lib/libtesseract.5.dylib 要求 15.7.5，而目标为 15.0。
本地同版本 Qt 6.11.2 定向用例已通过；完整四层验收结果记录在 stage_summaries，未执行 push，因此没有宣称远端重跑。
diagnosis.deduction: 两个最新失败共享同一测试方法和同一错误观测器。唯一修复是按因果顺序把首个 Paint 归于滚动、把后续异步 Paint 仅作诊断，并等待 refinement 完成后清理；无需修改生产渲染逻辑、放宽 5% 阈值或重试失败。Release 仍保留三段版本数值比较、15.0 双架构源码 Ghostscript 和签名前闭合校验。

repairs.change: 增加三段 minos 比较、无凭据版本单元入口，并在 macdeployqt 后强制覆盖为目标版本的源码 Ghostscript runtime
增加目标版本/架构校验、固定源码构建 flags 和禁用不需要的 Tesseract/桌面可选集成
以滚动后的首个 Paint 验证暴露条带，等待异步 refinement 收敛，并把后续最大 Paint 仅输出为诊断
增加滚动 Paint 因果隔离静态合同，更新最新远端诊断与多跳证据，并保留 QtTest 超时、失败 ID 和 Release 四层验收
